t: You're at the Priory Church of St Bartholomew the Great, a medieval church in Smithfield, in the City of London. It was founded as an Augustinian priory in 1123, and it stands beside St Bartholomew's Hospital, which shares the same foundation. The church is named for Bartholomew, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus. Mary Walsingham, who lived from 1525 to 1576, is buried here. This is one of the oldest churches in the City, and well worth stepping inside.
